title: 92 evacuated in Negros town as rains trigger Kanlaon lahar flow

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — Heavy rains sent mud and volcanic debris cascading down Ibid Creek in La Castellana, Negros Occidental, on Tuesday afternoon, prompting the evacuation of 92 residents from 27 families in a nearby high-risk area. The Philippine Red Cross (PRC) reported that the lahar flow occurred at around 5:30 p.m. in Sitio Tamburong, Barangay Biak-na-Bato, after the creek overflowed amid the downpour. Village Councilor Allan Tomaquin immediately coordinated the preemptive evacuation of residents in high-risk areas, according to La Castellana Public Information Officer Remuel Lajo.
